title: Discretized Markov-transition distance
intro_en: Map observations to three shared value states and count consecutive state transitions. Row-normalized count matrices describe the next-state distribution conditional on the current state. Compare these matrices by Frobenius distance. This illustrates a specified first-order discretization, without establishing that either signal is generated by a Markov chain.
intro_zh: 把观测映射到三个共享数值状态，统计连续状态转移。按行归一化的计数矩阵描述给定当前状态时的下一状态分布，再以 Frobenius 距离比较两个矩阵。这只是指定的一阶离散化示例，并未证明信号由 Markov 链生成。
steps_en: Use shared thresholds 0 and 0.7, then count consecutive transitions between the three states.
Divide each row by its outgoing-transition count; every row is observed in this example.
Square differences between corresponding conditional transition probabilities.
Sum these squared differences and take their square root, giving the Frobenius norm.
steps_zh: 用共享阈值 0 和 0.7 定义三个状态，再统计连续转移。
用各行转出总数进行归一化；本例每行均有观测。
对相对应的条件转移概率计算差的平方。
累加这些平方差并开平方，得到 Frobenius 范数。
caveats_en: State boundaries and sampling interval define the estimated transitions; independently chosen bins would not have matching meanings.
Unobserved rows need a documented smoothing or missing-row policy. No smoothing is used here because every row has observations.
First-order transition matrices discard longer history and do not prove causal equivalence or equal state occupancy.
caveats_zh: 状态边界和采样间隔决定转移估计；分别选取的分箱可能不具有对应含义。
未观测行需要明确平滑或缺失规则。本例每行均有观测，因此不平滑。
一阶转移矩阵舍弃更长历史，也不能证明因果等价或状态占比相同。
